research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official frozen/current CV, personal biography, 2003 UK inquiry memorandum, first speech, first-person business interview, contemporaneous ABC reporting, publisher and government library records, and historical biography/catalogue leads inspected.

Military 1980–2001, private Raytheon 2000–01 and early ONA service overlap. Primary evidence mentions ONA work in 1998; secondary accounts start in 1999. These may reflect attachments or imprecise CV dates. Preserve all supported facts; do not sum overlapping spells or silently truncate Army service.

Hours remain unknown for Army, ONA and Raytheon. No full-time inference from rank, senior title or government payroll. Missing public/private totals are not zero. Earlier school-age work, service leave and breaks remain unestablished.

Rug-shop name searches did not establish a reliable entity link. Do not attach similarly named ABN entries without evidence. First-person three-year statement does not justify replacing frozen 2008–10 with invented day dates. Ownership differs from actual full-time working duration.

Author occupation could include royalties, self-employment or paid commissions; inspect legitimate book previews, original publisher contract disclosures and member interests for concurrent post-2010 activity. Greens candidacies and earlier Liberal membership are political participation, not proof of paid employment.

Follow up ONA secondment and reappointment records, Army discharge/reserve and leave evidence, Raytheon appointment/promotion dates and actual hours, business trading identity/hours/sale, writing arrangements and study overlap. No outreach, paid access or private-profile access used.

Follow-up2026-10-02: searched regular/reserve Army status, ONA secondment/reappointment and Raytheon transitions, publisher preview and rug-shop trading name/closure. ADM corroborates Regular Army background without dated boundaries. Publisher page contains no accessible career chapter preview. No materially new chronology or hours established.

ABC2003Lateline and WSWS references to a proposed full-time wartime team concern work he was due to undertake, not completed FT employment. Guardian wording about handling media calls being a full-time job is not evidence of paid work. Unanchored shop purchase/closure snippets and unrelated rug product names do not identify his business or exact term.

Source-only failures: Australian shop-closure article and ABC Wilkie considers watchdog role returned InternalError; search snippets insufficient to establish actual appointment or employment. Wikipedia inconsistently reports Army2004/2001and is not used to replace frozen evidence. No source-access failure terminated the job.

Follow-up priority remains legitimate public memoir excerpt/primary service record for Army–ONA–Raytheon transitions; business-name evidence tied to Wilkie and actual work-hours records. Missing hours and overlap prevent public/private totals.
